notes: Governmental funds on the modified cash basis (pp4-5, Total Governmental Funds column); business-type funds on the accrual basis (pp6-7, Total column), as in FY2023/FY2024. Fund balances in the fund_balance fields (p5); ending_cash = sum of the governmental cash lines on the funds balance sheet (p4), certificate of deposits as ending_investments; no beginning cash printed. Governmental transfers are printed only as a net 'Transfers in (out)' per fund; the Total column net +22,116 (from the Electric Fund) is recorded as transfers_in. Bond/loan proceeds 4,947,995 are printed among revenues (Flood Control Fund) and are a receipt line. Business-type receipts total = operating revenues + nonoperating interest income; disbursements total = operating expenses + loss on sale of asset + interest expense + loan fees (no single printed totals). Proprietary cash flows left null (as FY2023/FY2024). Detail: General Fund from the departments schedule (pp17-18; supersedes the General Fund budget schedule p10, not recorded); Cemetery and Recycling departments are counted in the statement's Public works line (p5 General Fund public works 30,670 = their non-capital spending) and are categorised streets/highways; their capital outlay is plain 'Capital Outlay' (no function printed). Street, Sales Tax, Golf Board, Flood Control and Debt Service funds from their budget schedules (pp11-15; zero-actual budget-only lines such as Street bond proceeds, Flood Control sales tax and Debt Service property tax are not recorded; budget '-' recorded as 0). Street Fund schedule prints 'Transfers out 22,116' but adds it to the fund (an inflow; recorded +22,116 with review). Six nonmajor funds from the combining statement (p16). No business-type detail lines (as FY2023/FY2024). Read pages 1-18 of 18
